name: flametal-ball-items
description: D-145 (user 2026-11-21): the Flametal Cannon Ball is 4 Flametal (FlametalNew) at the Black Forge, stacks to 50 (D-182), has its own icon; the iron ball and the cartridge carry their new names; T-017: a dropped ball (iron and flametal) is drawn once, not twice

steps.name: GunPowdered.recipeOf
steps.expect: blackforge level 1, makes 1, enabled True: FlametalNew x4
steps.label: 4 Flametal at the Black Forge

steps.name: GunPowdered.recipeOf
steps.expect: forge level 2, makes 1, enabled True: Iron x2
steps.label: the iron ball's recipe is unchanged

steps.name: GunPowdered.droppedBallModels
steps.expect: own model shown True, hand copy shown False, drawn 1 time(s)
steps.label: T-017: a dropped Iron Cannon Ball is drawn once (not its hand copy too)

steps.name: GunPowdered.droppedBallModels
steps.expect: own model shown True, hand copy shown False, drawn 1 time(s)
steps.label: T-017: a dropped Flametal Cannon Ball is drawn once
